summary: Can-Fite BioPharma filed a Form 6-K furnishing a November 2, 2026 press release disclosing that the Eurasian Patent Office issued a notification of readiness to grant a patent covering Piclidenoson for OCRL-deficiency diseases, including Lowe syndrome and Dent disease 2. No transaction, price, stake or premium is stated. The application is owned by Fondazione Telethon; Can-Fite holds development, commercialization and out-licensing rights under their collaboration, with an open-label Phase 2 trial enrolling 5 adults. Grant remains subject to formalities. Watch IP issuance, trial data and partnering as catalysts.
